systems.country_label: WAPIS; future WAPIS data collection and registration centre (DACORE)
systems.owner: INTERPOL programme, funded by the European Union (11th EDF); Liberia signed the memorandum of understanding with INTERPOL, among the first to do so
systems.tiers: Liberia joined in November 2017. A first batch of equipment (workstations, scanners, servers) was handed over in Liberia on 5 July 2019 to start digitising paper-based police data; premises for the future national centre were found and being refurbished, with inauguration expected at the end of 2019; first training delivered in August or early September 2019. No centre operating and no station named.

note: No fact: for Liberia the newsletter reports a donation of equipment and a centre not yet opened, to digitise existing paper police data; it does not say that any station enters reports or cases in the system, so it is unclassified. English edition of the same issue as document 61.
